instinct.huddle: Huddle (force orchestration_graph chain, then fold one melody) when the brief asks to make something AND (find a path, fold one voice, or judge a gap), OR the brief has three or more clauses longer than 18 characters, OR the brief is longer than 340 characters and asks to make something.
instinct.quiet: Otherwise stay quiet. One room can carry it. The huddle stays behind the door.
when: make something AND (find a path OR fold one voice OR judge a gap)
three or more clauses longer than 18 characters
longer than 340 characters AND make something

skills.seam: The player still meets one party.

graphs.note: Huddle forces orchestration_graph chain. skill_graph is the skill's own graph. Never one field for both.
